resources.string: Adjust eye, brow, mouth and tongue response. Your presets and unsaved changes stay in the tuning panel.

Share the mouth and both eye cameras with apps on your network. Cameras run only while a client subscribes. Turning this off disconnects all three streams; closing this app leaves the service running. Your choice is remembered after a restart.
Anyone on the same network can view these images while sharing is on. Use a trusted private network.
Share both eyes’ expression values with apps on this network while LAN cameras are on. Does not change image or Facial Bridge sharing.
Let apps on this network receive mouth tracking values while LAN cameras are on. This does not affect camera images or Facial Bridge.
The running camera service does not support this switch. Turn LAN cameras off and on with the matching module installed.
The service did not confirm the result switch. Check the status before trying again.
Address available when sharing is ready
The module has not replied. Install the matching module backend; the switch has not been confirmed.
The module is still completing this operation. Wait for its status reply.
Close other eye and face tracking clients once to prepare sharing. The service will start when tracking is idle.
Waiting for the tracking service to become available.
A separately started camera adapter is already resident. Stop that development session and restart the tracking service before using this switch.
The matching camera components are missing from the module.
Shutdown has not been acknowledged. Sharing is not confirmed off; retry Off and keep the service files.
Another module operation is running. Try the switch again when it finishes.
The camera adapter could not start. Check the module log before retrying.
The transport process could not open its endpoints. Check the module log.
The camera adapter has not acknowledged the command.
The camera and transport process could not establish a shared session.
The tracking service changed during this operation. Refresh the status and try again.
